''From the 1881 Household Cyclopedia''

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* [[Cookbook:Flour|Flour]]

== Procedure ==

# Beat the egg. Mix and knead in flour until you have a very stiff [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] the dough out into a thin sheet.
# Sprinkle the dough with a good amount of flour to prevent it from sticking to itself. Tightly roll up the dough to make a log.
# Use a sharp [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]] to cut the log cross-wise into thin slices, similar to how you would slice cabbage for slaw. Unroll the noodles and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] with flour.
# Add the noodles to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] soup. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 10 minutes.
